To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the fuel cell based battery/fuel-cell APU can be integrated into an AEPS to provide the power quality required to support nonlinear loads.
the fuel cell-based APU can provide a reliable power source to the aircraft power system and can be integrated into the aircraft electric power system to provide the required power to the loads.
a fuel cell based AUP integrated with a nonlinear load can cause a significant increase in the voltage ripple at the main bus of an aircraft electric power system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the transient performance of battery/fuelfuel-cell-based APU in aircraft electric power system with large share of nonlinear loading.
a transient analysis of an integrated AEPS model under large nonlinear loading, and the effects of the nonlinear loads on power quality of aircraft electric power system are studied and discussed.
the transient performance and power quality of an AEPS with a battery/fuel cell based APU and nonlinear loads.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the transient performance of the aircraft electric power system with a battery/fuel cell based APU is acceptable under large share of nonlinear loadings.
the fuel cell based APUs are able to supply the nonlinear loads without any significant degradation in voltage quality.
, the proposed battery/fuel-cell APU model is able to provide a high level of power quality for a VSCF AEPS under nonlinear load.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the transient performance of the AEFS with nonlinear loads is acceptable, however, with the presence of nonlinear loads, the AEFS needs to be equipped with a shunt power filter for the sake of power quality.
the fuel cell based battery APU is capable of providing the required transient power for aircraft electric power systems.
a battery/fuel cell based APU is a feasible solution to provide power to aircraft electric power systems during transient conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the transient performance of a battery/fue cell based APU on aircraft power systems is affected by the nonlinear loading of the system and the fuel cell control strategy.
a fuel-cell based APU is capable of supplying a large portion of the aircraft electrical power demand, especially under nonlinear loading.
the fuel cell based aircraft APU can provide a significant improvement to the power quality of the aircraft electric power system under nonlinear loading.
